description: Retrieve detailed product info from Google's immersive product popup via a page token.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code to geo-target results (e.g. us, gb, in, de). (API default: us)

language.description: Result language code (e.g. en, es, fr, de). (API default: en)

page_token.description: Immersive-product token (from a Google Shopping/Search response).

sori.description: Seller pagination cursor; works with stores.

stores.description: Enable seller pagination (requires sori). (API default: false)

name: google_immersive_product
title: Google Immersive Product API
